key_idea: Find the places of Nina and Tom in the line.
steps: There are 4 children in front of Nina, so Nina is number 5 in the line.
Tom stands right behind Nina, so Tom is number 6.
There are 9 children in all. 9 - 6 = 3 children are behind Tom.

choice_feedback.A: Tom is number 6 of 9, so there are 3 children behind him, not 1.
choice_feedback.B: Tom is number 6 of 9, so there are 3 children behind him, not 2.
choice_feedback.D: 4 children are behind Nina. Tom stands behind Nina, so 1 fewer are behind Tom.
choice_feedback.E: Tom is number 6 of 9, so only 3 children are behind him.
